title: Quality Assurance Schedule of Guarantees, Return Windows and Scale Tolerances
content:
What the mill warrants about a ration, which classes of feed may come back, how long a return stands open and the tolerances applied to weight are settings of the programme within the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes.

| Programme | What the mill warrants | Classes of feed that may come back | Return window, in calendar days from the delivery date |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | the guaranteed analysis on the tag | complete feed, mineral | 7 |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | the guaranteed analysis on the tag | complete feed, mineral | 7 |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | that the mix was run to the specification on file | mineral | 3 |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | that the mix was run to the specification on file | mineral | 3 |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | that the mix was run to the specification on file, with a performance review | mineral | 3 |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | that the mix was run to the directive and to the specification on file | nothing may come back | 0 |

## Tolerances on weight

| Programme | Tolerance on the weight delivered before a claim is entertained | Tolerance between the mill scale and the member's scale before a reweigh is ordered |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | 0.50 percent | 1.00 percent |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | 0.50 percent | 1.00 percent |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | 0.50 percent | 1.00 percent |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | 0.50 percent | 0.50 percent |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | 0.50 percent | 0.50 percent |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | 0.50 percent | 0.50 percent |

## Points of judgement on the schedule

The Bagged Feed Cash Account and the Bulk Delivered Feed Account are warranted to the guaranteed analysis on the tag. The Custom Mix Ration Program, the Contracted Ingredient Program and the Full Nutrition Partner Program are warranted to the specification on file, with a performance review added on the last of the three. The Medicated Feed VFD Program is warranted against both the directive and the specification on file.

The tolerance on the weight delivered stands at half a percent on all six programmes. The tolerance between the two scales is a full percent on the three lowest programmes and half a percent on the Contracted Ingredient Program, the Full Nutrition Partner Program and the Medicated Feed VFD Program.

*Hypothetical.* Mineral delivered on a Custom Mix Ration Program on the eighth of a month stands inside that programme's three calendar days on the eleventh and outside them on the twelfth.
